## Description
Please include a summary of the change, relevant motivation, and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Security / Policy enhancement (new Rego rule or posture check)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have added unit tests for any new Rego policy in `policies/tests/`
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass (`python -m pytest tests/ -v`)
- [ ] No secrets or private keys are committed
